compute: local macOS CPU and MPS; no paid cloud rental
parallelism: Three disjoint local workers: first seven tasks; TabFormer; IEEE-CIS then IBM AML. Each uses two CPU threads, the same frozen source fingerprint and full-sweep arguments. Completed records are reused only by exact-config resume. Final full-sweep command validates all 300 records. After the other datasets completed, TabFormer was split into disjoint SVM versus PCA/HBOS/GMM/neural workers; completed SVM seeds were preserved and the pending seed resumed from a fresh identical fit. All use the original full-sweep run configuration.
timing_limitations: Per-run elapsed times include concurrent workloads and shared hardware activity; not a controlled runtime comparison.
numerical_fix: Full fresh sweep after GMM float64 covariance fix; old 219 successful preliminary runs preserved separately and excluded.
environment_isolation: Task venv used system-site-packages over the bundled Python runtime. All experiment dependency versions are recorded in requirements-lock.txt and environment.json; unrelated workspace packages are not part of the dependency closure.
